Candidate_0_All_Innings.description: Retain 100% of genuine batting opportunities. No exclusion.

Candidate_1_Contextual_Zero_Impact.description: Exclude only ultra-short non-dismissal innings (<= 2 balls) with near-zero trajectory and score delta (|C_raw| <= 0.10).
Candidate_1_Contextual_Zero_Impact.flaw_summary: Minimal collateral damage, but still risks dropping valid minor support contributions.

Candidate_2_Crude_Balls_LE_2.description: Exclude all innings where batter faced 2 or fewer balls.
Candidate_2_Crude_Balls_LE_2.flaw_summary: Errs by dropping 592 match-winning last-ball finishes and rapid cameo boundaries!

Candidate_3_Crude_Balls_LE_5.description: Exclude all innings where batter faced 5 or fewer balls.
Candidate_3_Crude_Balls_LE_5.flaw_summary: Catastrophic failure: drops 1,178 high-impact death cameos (including 30 off 5, 20 off 5)!

Candidate_4_Crude_Runs_LT_10.description: Exclude all innings where batter scored fewer than 10 runs.
Candidate_4_Crude_Runs_LT_10.flaw_summary: Severe bias: drops 1,210 crucial late-order cameos (e.g. 8 off 3, 9 off 4 in tight chases) and rewards low-SR passenger knocks!

statistical_justification_analysis.verdict: Insufficient evidence for a hard exclusion threshold.
rationale: 1. Short innings (<= 5 balls) contain a high density of game-deciding moments (last-over cameos, match-winning boundaries, Super Over equivalents).
2. Crude balls thresholds (<=2 or <=5) drop between 480 and 1,100 high-impact knocks, introducing severe bias against lower-order finishers.
3. Crude runs thresholds (<10) unfairly penalize explosive bursts (e.g. 9 off 3 at 300 SR) while preserving slow knocks (e.g. 11 off 18 at 61 SR).
4. Phase 5B contextual contribution already appropriately rates low-leverage knocks near Par (48-52) and gives genuine match-winners high recognition (75-90).
5. Therefore, ALL genuine batting innings must be retained in the primary season metric.
6. A secondary qualified metric is provided solely for comparative sensitivity analysis, excluding only near-zero impact non-dismissal innings.

final_recommendation.primary_metric: All-Innings Season Metrics (includes 100% of actual batting opportunities, strictly excludes DNB).
final_recommendation.secondary_metric: Qualified Season Metrics (transparency layer for sensitivity analysis).
